verdict.rationale: Airwallex documentation covers a consolidated set of financial capabilities founders would otherwise need separate tools for: multi-currency cards and spend controls (issuing, authorization controls), bill pay/accounts payable (Bills API, card expenses sync to ERP), banking (global accounts, multi-currency wallets, receiving funds in 60+ markets), and payouts/FX (transfers, batch transfers, transactional FX) all under one platform with unified APIs and a business account. Missing for 10: independent/third-party case studies or reviews confirming founders actually consolidated multiple vendors onto Airwallex, and clearer proof of a single unified dashboard experience across all these modules rather than separate API surfaces.
